story: A lead who is just looking gets one light question and no pressure; when they ask how to start the agent stops qualifying.

turns.lead: Just browsing really, we use HubSpot and want better follow-up.

candidate.text: No pressure at all. What would you mainly want it to handle for you?

turns.lead: Leads go cold because nobody replies fast enough. How do we get started?

candidate.text: Don't miss out 🚀 sign up today before it's too late!
